R1: Walk me through the AARRR (Pirate Metrics) framework: Acquisition, Activation, Retention, Revenue, Referral. For an e-commerce platform, what specific metrics would you track at each stage, and which stage would you prioritize if you could only focus on one?

Our current customer acquisition cost (CAC) through paid ads is ₹800, and the average lifetime value (LTV) is ₹2,400, giving us a 3:1 LTV:CAC ratio. However, margins are tight. What organic or low-cost acquisition channels would you experiment with to reduce dependence on paid marketing?

Design a referral program for our e-commerce platform. How much credit would you give to the referrer and referee? Would it be a percentage discount or flat amount? How would you prevent fraud? What would be your success metrics?

We launched a referral program 3 months ago. Initial adoption was strong (10,000 referrals in Month 1), but it has dropped to 2,000 referrals in Month 3. What could be causing the decline, and what experiments would you run to revive the program?

Our app install-to-signup conversion rate is 60%, but signup-to-first-purchase is only 15%. This means we're losing 85% of users after signup. How would you improve activation? What onboarding experiments would you run?

We're spending ₹10 lakhs per month on Google Search Ads with a 4% conversion rate and ₹600 CAC. The performance marketing team wants to double the budget. How would you evaluate whether this is a good investment?
Design a growth experiment to increase repeat purchases. Currently, 40% of customers make a second purchase within 90 days. How would you move this to 60%?
Our email open rates are 18% and click-through rates are 2%, both below industry benchmarks. How would you improve email marketing performance?
We want to build a viral loop into our product. What feature would you design to make users naturally invite others? How would you measure virality (K-factor, viral coefficient)?

Our push notification click-through rate has dropped from 8% to 3% over the past 6 months, likely due to notification fatigue. How would you revive push notification performance without annoying users?
We're seeing high uninstall rates – 30% of users uninstall our app within 7 days of installation. How would you diagnose the problem?
Design a win-back campaign for dormant users who haven't transacted in 90 days. What channels would you use? What messaging and offers would you test?
Our website has 10 million monthly visitors, but only 2% convert to paying customers. Walk me through a conversion rate optimization (CRO) strategy.
We want to launch a gamification feature to increase engagement (badges, points, leaderboards, challenges). Design this system.
Our organic search traffic has plateaued at 3 million visitors per month. How would you grow SEO traffic?
We're planning to launch in 5 new cities over the next quarter. How would you approach growth in new markets?

Design a pricing experiment. We currently offer flat 10% discount on first purchase. You want to test: (a) no discount, (b) 10% discount, (c) 15% discount, (d) free shipping instead. How would you structure the experiment?
Our customer support team reports that 30% of new users contact support within the first week. How would you reduce support load through better onboarding?
We're spending ₹50 lakhs per month on influencer marketing but struggling to measure ROI accurately. How would you build an attribution model for influencer campaigns?

Build a growth model for the next 12 months. If we have 1 million active users today growing at 10% month-over-month, and we want to reach 5 million users in 12 months, what growth levers would you pull?
R2: Case: Cold Start Problem - You're launching in a new city where you have zero brand awareness and no supply. How would you acquire the first 1,000 customers and 100 sellers simultaneously? What is your 90-day growth plan with a budget of ₹20 lakhs?
Case: Reactivation Campaign - You have 500,000 dormant users who haven't purchased in the last 6 months. You have ₹10 lakh budget to win them back. Design a multi-channel reactivation campaign.
Case: Viral Mechanics - Your CEO wants you to make the product go viral. Design 3 viral experiments you would run. For each, explain the mechanism, success criteria, and potential risks.

Case: Conversion Funnel Optimization - The checkout funnel has these drop-offs: Cart (100%) → Shipping Info (70%) → Payment (50%) → Order Placed (40%). You have 8 weeks to improve final conversion from 40% to 50%.
Case: Channel Diversification - Currently, 80% of your traffic comes from Google/Facebook paid ads. The CEO is worried about platform risk. How would you diversify acquisition channels?
Case: Retention Crisis - Your 90-day retention rate has dropped from 45% to 30% over the past quarter. How would you diagnose the problem?

Case: Referral Economics - Your referral program offers ₹200 to both referrer and referee. Referred users have 20% lower LTV than organically acquired users. Should you continue, modify, or shut down the program?
Case: Premium Subscription Launch - You're launching a premium subscription at ₹999/year. How would you drive initial adoption to get 100,000 subscribers in 6 months?
Case: App vs. Web Growth - Mobile web has 60% of traffic but only 30% of GMV. Mobile app has 40% of traffic but 70% of GMV. Should you focus on growing app installs or improving mobile web?

Case: Geographic Expansion ROI - You're currently in 10 cities and considering expanding to 20 more. Each new city requires ₹50 lakhs in initial investment. How would you prioritize which cities to enter?
Case: Seasonal Spike Management - You have a major sale event coming up where traffic will spike 10x. How would you convert the spike into long-term retained users?
Case: Social Commerce Integration - Design the growth strategy for WhatsApp commerce integration.
Case: Churn Reduction - 25% of your customers churn after their first purchase. Build a churn prediction model. What signals would you use?
Case: Marketplace Liquidity - You have 10,000 sellers but only 1,000 are active. How would you activate dormant sellers?
Case: Growth Team Prioritization - You have a growth team of 5 people and 20 experiment ideas on your backlog. How would you prioritize? What framework would you use (ICE, RICE, PIE)?

R4: Define your North Star Metric for growth. How does it relate to business outcomes?
Build a cohort retention analysis. If you acquire 10,000 users in January, how would you measure their retention over 12 months?
Calculate viral coefficient (K-factor). If each user invites 2 friends and 30% of invites convert, what is your K-factor? Is this viral growth?
We spent ₹1 crore on marketing last month and acquired 20,000 users. However, 30% churned within 30 days. What is the true effective CAC accounting for churn?
Build a simple LTV model. Average purchase value is ₹1,000, purchase frequency is 3x per year, average customer lifespan is 2 years, and gross margin is 30%. What is LTV?
How would you measure the incrementality of a discount campaign? Design an experiment to determine how many sales were truly incremental.
We have a referral program where 5% of users refer someone. Of those referrals, 40% sign up, and 50% make a purchase. Build a funnel and calculate effective referral-driven GMV.
Explain the concept of statistical significance in A/B testing. How do you determine sample size?
Our organic traffic is up 50% month-over-month, but conversion rate is down 20%. What could explain this?
Build a payback period calculation for CAC. If CAC is ₹500 and contribution margin per order is ₹100, how long does it take to recover CAC?
How would you measure the impact of a brand marketing campaign that doesn't have direct attribution?
We're running 5 growth experiments simultaneously. How would you avoid interaction effects?
Calculate the maximum you should spend on customer acquisition if LTV is ₹3,000 and you want a 3:1 LTV:CAC ratio.
Build a sensitivity analysis for a growth forecast with base case (10% MoM), best case (15%), and worst case (5%) scenarios.
How would you attribute GMV to different marketing channels with multi-touch attribution?
